messages:
julia_cs: Heads-up — Novus Clinic needs a short-lived APAC config change for a live product demo in ~48h. They requested region pin to ap-southeast-1, an IP allowlist for their firewall, session affinity for interactive sessions, and a temporary rate-window increase. Renewal touch in ~4 weeks; demo outcome ties to renewal.

julia_cs: Requested window: start 2024-10-05T08:00Z, duration 36h, requested rate_window=1200 rpm per key. Prefer model redwood-std-2 (fallback redwood-std-2q). Org: 03J6B4C2. Masked key sk-***4b2. IPs: 203.119.0.0/18, 203.120.64.0/18. CS score 68, renewal risk moderate.

omar_se: looping in SRE/infra. Quick clarifying q: do they want any reserved capacity? And confirm whether session affinity should be cookie-based or header-based.

julia_cs: No reserved capacity requested. They prefer cookie-based session affinity to preserve SDK session state. I'll DM the full key.

mei_sre: We can apply a pinned routing policy to ap-southeast-1, enable cookie session_affinity, and bump the rate_window with a TTL and auto-revert. Suggest fallback to ap-northeast-1 with lower weight in case of regional pressure. Need full key and confirmation of exact UTC start/end. We'll add an alert if p95 latency > 800ms.

rachel_ops: Confirming: if it's just IP allowlist we can proceed without peering/legal. If they had asked for BGP peering we'd need commercial signoff.

julia_cs: They confirmed "allowlist only" — no BGP.

infra-bot: Created INF-5101: "Novus Clinic APAC pin + 1200rpm (36h)" assigned to mei_sre.

mei_sre: Plan INF-5101: 1) set routing.pin for org 03J6B4C2 -> ap-southeast-1; 2) set session_affinity=cookie; 3) rate_window=1200 rpm with TTL 129600 (36h); 4) add allowed IPs; 5) add fallback ap-northeast-1 lower weight; 6) tag billing/cs and add monitoring hooks. ETA 2h after full key received.

julia_cs: Please add a 30-min enablement at T-24h and a short feedback survey after the demo. They prefer APAC mornings.

mei_sre: Config snippet (values masked in thread):
```
org_id: 03J6B4C2
api_key_mask: sk-***4b2
rate_window: 1200
window_ttl_seconds: 129600  # 36h
routing:
  primary_region: ap-southeast-1
  fallbacks: [ap-northeast-1]
session_affinity: cookie
allowed_ips: ["203.119.0.0/18", "203.120.64.0/18"]
```

infra-bot: INF-5101 status: in_progress (assigned mei_sre)

mei_sre: Applied routing.pin and rate_window bump at 1755551200. Billing tag "cs-temp-apac-novus" attached. Monitoring + rollback hook created.

deploybot: config-change: INF-5101 completed by mei_sre at 1755551205. Applied: routing.pin(ap-southeast-1), session_affinity=cookie, rate_window=1200 (TTL 36h), fallback ap-northeast-1, IP allowlist added.

julia_cs: Novus confirms traffic is hitting APAC primary and demo runs look stable so far. They had to flush SDK DNS cache due to old IPs cached locally — note for docs: remind customers to clear local DNS/DNS TTL when whitelisting our IPs.

omar_se: I'll schedule a quick post-demo perf/quality check — token-level latencies and any fallbacks to redwood-std-2q.

mei_sre: INF-5101 auto-revert scheduled at 1755686400 (36h TTL). Will keep open until post-demo validation complete.

julia_cs: Post-demo verbal feedback: execs impressed, asked for a small reserved-pool pricing estimate at renewal. Renewal risk lowered — great job team :rocket:

deploybot: INF-5101 status: scheduled_revert at 1755686400
